# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Messages

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta under Messages. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Messages

- [Batches](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Cancel a Message Batch](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/cancel.md): Batches may be canceled any time before processing ends.
- [Count tokens in a Message](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/count_tokens.md): Count the number of tokens in a Message.
- [Create a Message](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/create.md): Send a structured list of input messages with text and/or image content, and the model will generate the next message in the conversation.
- [Create a Message Batch](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/create.md): Send a batch of Message creation requests.
- [Delete a Message Batch](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/delete.md): Delete a Message Batch.
- [List Message Batches](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Retrieve a Message Batch](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/retrieve.md): This endpoint is idempotent and can be used to poll for Message Batch completion.
- [Retrieve Message Batch results](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages/batches/results.md): Streams the results of a Message Batch as a `.jsonl` file.
